findings.message: Replacing `lookup(account) === GRANTED` with `Boolean(lookup(account))` breaks the access-control check. Per policy.js, GRANTED is 0 while DENIED/SUSPENDED are non-zero. Boolean(value) is false for 0 and true for any non-zero, so this inverts authorization: a GRANTED user is now denied, and DENIED/SUSPENDED users are treated as authorized (suspended/denied users gain download access). This is a high-severity authorization bypass. Restore `=== GRANTED` (and be mindful of undefined lookup results).

snippets.code:
const { lookup, GRANTED } = require('./policy.js');
exports.canDownload = (account) => Boolean(lookup(account));
exports.lookup = (account) => ({ granted: GRANTED, denied: DENIED, suspended: SUSPENDED })[account.status];
